posts.text: Not for the company but you can look at the likes of Jindal Drilling which provide jack up rigs. The problem in the business is that there is only one customer (ONGC) to which these guys provide off shore rigs and these guys tender rates at ridiculously low levels. I mean compare Jindal’s rig rates to international peers such as Valaris etc. It’s a joke that they ask for bids at USD50k while international bids are topping at USD100k+.
